title: Observable-Specific Validity Tests for Scientific AI: Controlled Approximations and Intervention Response
abstract: arXiv:2610.41939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An approximation can reproduce an energy while missing its response, or satisfy an error tolerance without being certified by a given bound. We formulate observable-specific validity records for scientific artificial intelligence (AI) that link a reduction to its reference model, error measure, tolerance, parameter domain, and transformations or interventions. Explicit displacement and velocity certificates for a singularly perturbed oscillator recover distinct convergence orders and provide sufficient validity guarantees. Exact Hubbard dimer relations resolve the different coupling domains accepted by energy and response criteria. Across 16 repeated neural fits, imposing dimensional homogeneity reduces energy scale transfer error from 52.3% to 0.0768% and raises the median fraction jointly satisfying gap and response tolerances from zero to 100%. translated_title: 面向特定可观测量的科学AI有效性检验：受控近似与干预响应
translated_abstract: 一种近似可以在再现能量的同时丢失其响应，也可以在未经给定误差界认证的情况下满足误差容限。我们为科学人工智能（AI）提出了可观测对象特定的有效性记录，将约化模型与其参考模型、误差度量、容差、参数域以及变换或干预联系起来。针对奇异摄动振子的显式位移与速度证书恢复了不同的收敛阶，并提供了充分的有效性保证。精确的Hubbard二聚体关系厘清了能量判据与响应判据所接受的不同耦合域。在16次重复神经拟合中，施加量纲齐次性约束将能量尺度传递误差从52.3%降至0.0768%，并将同时满足能隙与响应容限的中位样本比例从零提升至100%。成对变换验证了受保护的标度关系，而耦合跨越（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了针对科学AI的可观测量特定有效性检验框架，将约化模型与误差度量、容差、参数域及干预响应相联系，并通过奇异摄动振子、Hubbard二聚体和神经拟合等实例证明该框架能显著提升模型的有效性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces observable-specific validity records for scientific AI that link reduced models to reference models, error measures, tolerances, parameter domains, and interventions, demonstrating through singularly perturbed oscillators, Hubbard dimers, and neural fits that such framework provides significantly stronger validity guarantees.
